# Archived cases

Retired from the game on 3 October 2026. They are kept for reference and as test material, not offered in the case menu.

- `mk-bw-*.json` (the five first shipped cases) and `live/` (nine cases generated on 27 September; not in git).
- Why: they were generated before "the history is the only source of facts". Each carries facts added after
  generation (publish-time clues, a backfilled examination or discovery, or attitudes added by
  `tools/refine-c/repair_history.py`), and the earliest ones repeat each other (Silas kills Edmund for money in seven).

- `2026-10/`: nine certified cases retired from the menu on 24 October 2026 when it was narrowed to six; see its README.
